### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, touching **36** documentable anchor(s).

**22** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 21667430198863ce947f31cce4b37d14650425a0`.

⛔ **8** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `organization_id (literal, 40 pages)`, `sys_user (literal, 50 pages)`
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **22** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 21667430198863ce947f31cce4b37d14650425a0` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `d5d648fa1ad18fcca6f5ed423e25070b010516fd` — the merge of head `cbda058550beac8f341b7766c729b85261d311e4` into base `21667430198863ce947f31cce4b37d14650425a0`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin d5d648fa1ad18fcca6f5ed423e25070b010516fd && git checkout d5d648fa1ad18fcca6f5ed423e25070b010516fd
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 21667430198863ce947f31cce4b37d14650425a0 cbda058550beac8f341b7766c729b85261d311e4 && git checkout -B drift-repro 21667430198863ce947f31cce4b37d14650425a0 && git merge --no-ff cbda058550beac8f341b7766c729b85261d311e4

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 21667430198863ce947f31cce4b37d14650425a0
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 21667430198863ce947f31cce4b37d14650425a0` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：SCIM 建号（`POST /Users`）遇到同邮箱的已有账号时，满足三条就把该账号接给这条 SCIM 连接（201），否则照旧 409：账号是 `idp_provisioned` 且无密码凭据、尚未被任何 SCIM 主体持有；账号链接在本组织的某个 SSO 提供方上；该提供方已做域名验证且邮箱域名正好在它的域名单里。409 文案去掉 "Better Auth User"。
- 为什么改：先开 SSO（JIT 建号）后开 SCIM 是标准上线顺序，现在这些员工在 Entra ID / Okta 同步时一律 409，离职停用与组变更到不了他们（#32148，裁定 A）。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽三条全满足的情形，绝不按裸邮箱匹配；任何判断失败都落回 409 或 500，不放行。只改 `plugin-auth` 6 个文件，回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-sso-adoption.ts`（判据）、`scim-conflict-detail.ts`（409 文案）。
- 需要你知道：域名验证默认关（`OS_SSO_DOMAIN_VERIFICATION=false`），未开验证的环境不会接管，仍 409；云端 `scim-entra-id.md` / `scim-okta.md` 需另立 cloud 卡写明。
- 席位意见：最高档契约审查 PASS，判据闭合、失败不放行；非受管面 920 行，席位落地。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:devx#2 · head `cbda058550beac8f341b7766c729b85261d311e4` · 2026-11-12T03:43Z

- **形态:** 6 files, +916/−4; `check-governed-merges --pr 32535`: NOT governed, 920 lines ≤ 3000 → ordinary queue landing. All paths inside Claim 6812545428's surface; `auth-manager-after-hook.ts` (#32431) and `packages/spec` untouched. Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay `pr_create`); dev report 6813585712.
- **前提实测:** on `origin/main` `89d815c50` no adoption seam was mounted; Step 0 found the vendor's `identity.resolveUser` → `{link}` seam in `@better-auth/scim` 1.7.12 (not a fork), mounted beside `reconcileUser` in `auth-manager-plugin-list.ts`.
- **契约审查（ceiling tier）:** PASS at `cbda0585`. Predicate closed: exact lowercase domain match (subdomain/IDN/trailing dot refuse); only providers the account itself is linked to can vouch; credential holders and SCIM-held accounts refuse (vendor `claimProfileSource` backstops the latter in-transaction); throws surface as SCIM 500, scope/engine gaps give `create` (= 409 on existing email). Org rule measured: mint stamps the named or Default Organization, provider register stamps the admin's active org (bootstrap owner of Default Organization) ⇒ the standard single-org flow matches; mismatches stay closed. 409 translation gated on status 409 + exact detail match, all four vendor details mapped, no new existence disclosure. Reviewer ran the 17 pins (17/17) and an own ablation (org + verified filters removed ⇒ 3 red, restored). Clause-② no; changeset `plugin-auth: patch` accurate.
- **门禁 check-runs:** head `cbda0585` at record time: 26 success, 16 skipped, 7 in progress, 0 red; auto-merge waits on the required set. Dev local: 64/66 families exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED (shallow-clone teardown fixture; dual-build CJS unbuilt, scoped substitute loaded), 0 UNRUN; red-first 13/16, ablations A1–A8 each red.
- **接受的偏差:** (1) GET-filter door not built: the vendor list endpoint has no host hook, and Entra/Okta's lookup(0) → create cycle links on create (pinned). (2) Two refusals beyond the ruled four (password holder, already SCIM-held) only narrow. (3) Condition 2 built strict: an org-less provider counts only when the credential is org-less too; relaxing it is the maintainer's call, not taken.
- **范围外去向:** non-blocking review notes for follow-up: the judge runs before the vendor transaction (a password set or provider un-verified in that window is not re-checked); "is an SSO provider" joins on `provider_id`, so an SSO provider registered with a social provider's id (e.g. `google`) would let that social account on the verified domain be adopted — bounded by DNS verification, passed to security#2; no end-to-end pin through the real register + mint flows. Cloud docs → separate cloud card.
- **落地条款:** K = 7 commits on `main` since base (< 15). Seat lands: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` in this stroke. On MERGED: close-out on #32148, remove `pm:dispatched`, tell the card thread.
